summary: Known community.general issue: jenkins_node can't update the offline message of a node that's already offline because it uses the toggleOffline API.
questions: Why can't jenkins_node change the offline message on an offline node?

answer_card.title: jenkins_node offline message limitation
answer_card.answer_md: `jenkins_node` can't update the offline message if the node is already offline, because it uses Jenkins' `toggleOffline` API internally. Bring the node online first, then take it offline with the new message.
